svg.title: Two observers — body-membrane, friction, planes-as-nodes
svg.desc: A restructured architecture. Each observer's body-harness is the outer membrane that anchors them to shared reality; everything latent (wrapper, dial, perceived global canon, idea domain, action-space) sits inside as a black hole to outside observers, partially penetrable via drugs, hypnosis, mental probes — itself a hidden protocol, the paradigm shift. Elevation is shown as an interconnected node graph, not a stack — sequence matters, hidden protocols know the order, widespread protocols get patched. The bottom band reframes resolution as friction regulation: not struggle vs union as outcomes to prefer, but freeze vs explode as the substrate's actual concern, with viability between. A side note shows that two observers maintaining asymmetry produces a unity signal at the next plane up — and vice versa.
svg.text: Body is the membrane · friction is regulated, not avoided · planes are interconnected nodes · sequence matters
not a stack — a network · sequence and access vary · hidden protocols know the order · once widespread → patched

svg.text: grounded in physical habitation — the latent anchor
The agnostic doesn't care about "home" as an outcome. It regulates the friction.
A⁺ and A⁻ pull and squeeze the fuzzy substrate via probability — release or absorb friction. Not for any observer; for the substrate itself.
struggle is necessary — it's the latent friction the substrate needs to keep its shape and produce its next move
Two observers, each their own body-membrane around their own latent black hole.
Asymmetry between them is the generative friction. Unity at the next plane up rides on it.
The agnostic doesn't want "home" any particular way. It wants the friction inside the viability band.
Expand to everything; compress to infinite. A⁺ releases; A⁻ absorbs. Sequence matters. Everything's a moving target.
